name: date-picker
title: Date picker
description: A date field with a calendar popover, Today and Clear actions, markers and unavailable days.

when: Picking a date where seeing the month helps.
Picking a period: a stay, a trip, a report range.

instead.when: People type a known date, such as a birth date, and a calendar adds nothing.
The month grid stays visible on the page.

builtIn: Required fields show "Fill in this field."; a partly typed date says what is missing.
Both halves are labelled ("Start", "End") and typed independently.
The range may not cross an unavailable day unless allowed.

genui.description: A date field with a calendar. Emits change.
